card.name: Linking words in pregnancy and elderly dosing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas in fixed label sentences, such as 'as' after 'presents', 'based' after 'appropriate,', and the comma after 'cautious'. They sit just before a phrase that gives a condition or timing.

modes.label: Neonatal withdrawal wording
modes.description: The word 'as' after 'Neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome presents'.
modes.example: Neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome presents<< as>> irritability, hyperactivity, abnormal sleep

modes.label: Fetal testing sentence
modes.description: 'based' or 'of' inside 'Fetal testing may be appropriate, based on the week of pregnancy'.
modes.example: Fetal testing may be appropriate,<< based>> on the week of pregnancy.

modes.label: Elderly dose selection
modes.description: The comma after 'should be cautious' in geriatric dosing text.
modes.example: dose selection for an elderly patient should be cautious<<,>> usually starting at the low end of the

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words meaning 'during' or 'after', which introduce a time or condition.
